subject: general
question:
A series is given with one term missing. Select the correct alternative from the given ones that will complete the series.

NMRQ, NDZG, NUHW, NLPM, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

**The logic followed here is :**

 
• **First letter - Remains same.**
 
• **Second letter - First subtraction of (9) and then addition of (17) in the position value in the alternate order.**
 
• **Third letter - (8) is added to the position value.**
 
• **Fourth letter - **First subtraction of (10) and then addition of (16) in the position value in the alternate order.

So,​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb91fd1be79250fb99e0ade366c3a9758eac09cb2279b3bc98303f1744531cc7.png] 

Hence, "**NCXC**" is the correct answer.
